title: Fix graph not loading when the img loads too fast or fail to load
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

The graph would never finish rendering when an img was present, but couldn't load.

Resolves #4439 

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

We check the `complete` attribute of the image, and listen for both the `load` and `error` event.
